name: Mystic
summary: A wooden-shipbuilding seaport frozen in the 1800s, a top aquarium, and the pizzeria that named a movie.

lodging.name: A Mystic riverfront inn
lodging.blurb: Walkable to the drawbridge and Seaport.

foodMustTry.name: A slice at Mystic Pizza
foodMustTry.blurb: Yes, the one from the movie — order the 'Slice of Heaven.'

days.label: Day 62 — The Seaport & Aquarium
days.summary: Living maritime history and beluga whales.

item.title: Mystic Seaport Museum
item.blurb: The largest maritime museum in the country — a recreated 19th-century village and the last wooden whaleship, the Charles W. Morgan.

item.title: Mystic Aquarium
item.blurb: Beluga whales, sea lions, and a strong New England aquarium, then the historic bascule drawbridge downtown.

days.label: Day 63 — Into Rhode Island
days.summary: A short hop to the capital of the smallest state.

commute.scenicNote: East across the state line into Rhode Island.
